answer: The strongest sybil-resistance is slow trust accumulation: each account builds a trust plume growing only with time and honest epochs, so influence equals age times honest epochs, and one fraud epoch resets it. New accounts start near zero influence however many are spun up; the entry wharf is a garden where reputations must be cultivated. An attacker must age thousands of accounts, paying compute, fees, and months of waiting, while one dishonest epoch forfeits the whole aged batch - making fake identities costlier than the influence they earn.
